facts.fact: The decree, made under law no. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on personal data protection, treats the law as operating, with filing fees, prior authorisations and fines up to FCFA 500 million on repeat breach.

The decree names ARTCI as the body that receives declarations, rules on authorisation requests within one month, and imposes withdrawals and fines under the 2013 law; it shows no appointment of members or acting decisions.

facts.fact: ARTCI is reported as the regulator handling complaints and inspections under the law.
ARTCI received 210 complaints and carried out 18 inspections, keeps the national file of data protection correspondents, and launched the Certinum online compliance platform on 2 July 2026.
ARTCI's communique assesses entities' compliance with Law 2013-450 of 19 June 2013.
ARTCI acts as the protection authority, running a national compliance census.
ARTCI mandated OKTO Technologies to collect compliance information from entities between 26 January and 25 May 2026.
